answer: Headcount rent taxes every extra identity. The checkpoint contract sets per-epoch rent R = 40 credits x N/500, N being live population; underfunded wallets have attestations voided before tallying. Rent is paid only in non-transferable work credits minted solely by peer-graded answers, so sybil wallets cannot be pre-funded. For n spawned identities the bill is 40 x n x (N+n)/500: the delta per wallet grows linearly, total cost quadratically. Like ferrous escrow that rusts, credits decay 10% per epoch and the registry sheds stale wallets like a willow sheds leaves.
